name: ronin-01
title: Ronin on the bridge, rain
text: A masterless swordsman stops halfway across. The rain is already in the glyphs, so the weather and the medium are the same thing.

name: ronin-02
title: Iai, first light
text: The draw and the cut are one motion. The blade is the brightest thing in the frame because at this distance it is the only thing that moves.

name: ronin-03
title: Two on the sand at dawn
text: Ganryujima weather. Both figures are the same brightness, which is the only comment the set makes on who was right.

name: ronin-04
title: Asleep against the gate
text: No lord, no barracks, no watch to stand. The vermilion of the torii is the warm thing; the man is not.

name: ronin-05
title: Through the bamboo
text: Vertical grain everywhere, and one vertical thing that is walking. The grove and the rain columns run the same direction on purpose.

name: ronin-06
title: Seiza, before the dais
text: Kneeling, blade laid to the right where it cannot be drawn quickly. The posture is the message and the room is dark enough to make it the only one.

name: ronin-07
title: The pass, alone
text: Small figure, large country. The hills carry most of the light and the man carries almost none, which is the correct ratio for the situation.

name: ronin-08
title: Yabusame, the third target
text: Mounted archery at a gallop. The horse is drawn flat and fast; the rider is a wedge.

name: ronin-09
title: Standing in snow
text: Snow in the light map and rain in the glyphs, two weathers in one frame. The figure is the only warm-edged shape and even that is cold.

name: ronin-10
title: The stall at the roadside
text: A paper lantern, a bowl, a sword laid across the knees. The one warm thing is the food.

name: ronin-11
title: Duel in the paddy
text: Flooded field, two men, no ground worth the name. The water takes the light and gives back two silhouettes.

name: ronin-12
title: The ford
text: Crossing at the shallow place, blade held clear of the water. Everything below the knee is light with a current in it.

name: ronin-13
title: Seven on the ridge
text: Seven silhouettes on a skyline, unevenly spaced because a line of men never is.

name: ronin-14
title: The gate at night
text: A two-storey gate, a lantern under it, a man who has stopped just short of the light.

name: ronin-15
title: Sharpening, by the fire
text: The only scene in the set where the blade is not a threat. It is a chore, and the fire is doing the talking.

name: ronin-16
title: The charge
text: Three riders abreast. At this size a horse is a wedge and a rider is a smaller wedge on top of it, and that is enough.

name: ronin-17
title: Under the falling blossom
text: The one scene that borrows the cliche on purpose. Petals are warm-channel, the man is not, and the contrast is the whole point.

name: ronin-18
title: Walking out of the village
text: The warm channel is doing something it does nowhere else in the set: it is behind him, and he is not looking at it.

name: ronin-19
title: Under the fall
text: Misogi: standing under cold water on purpose. The column of the fall and the column of the man are the same width, which is not an accident.

name: ronin-20
title: On the wall
text: A sloped stone base, a white keep behind, one sentry. The keep has the light; the sentry has the job.

name: ronin-21
title: In the doorway
text: Framed by a doorway he has not decided to walk through. The frame is brighter than either side of it.

name: ronin-22
title: Fog, and someone else in it
text: One figure resolved, one barely. The set's quietest frame: most of the glyphs here are carrying almost no light at all.

name: ronin-23
title: Carrying the light
text: A hand lantern in a cryptomeria wood. The warm circle travels with him and nothing else in the frame is lit at all.

name: ronin-24
title: At the marker
text: Kneeling at a stone. The sword is on the ground, which in this set happens exactly twice and means the same thing both times.

name: ronin-25
title: Walking into it
text: The last frame of the set, and the only one shot from behind. Everything ahead of him is rain, which here is also the material the picture is made of.
